package.name: morai_bridge
package.description: Adapter nodes translating between MORAI SIM's ROS2 Interface topics and this stack's simulator-agnostic /Car_1/* topics. Only exists because MORAI's message shapes (nav_msgs/Odometry for vehicle state, morai_v2_1_ros2_msgs/VehicleManualControl for control) differ from what perception/controller expect (a scalar speed, a Twist + Float32 steer).
